text.en:
No. S 93

BRUNEI NATIONAL PETROLEUM COMPANY SENDIRIAN BERHAD

ORDER, 2002 (S 6/02)

NOTICE ON THE GRANTING OF MINERAL RIGHTS BY

HIS MAJESTY THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN IN COUNCIL (section 3(1)) It is hereby notified that His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan in Council has, on the 9th. September, 2010 pursuant to section 3(1} of the Brunei National Petroleum Company Sendirian Berhad Order, 2002, granted all mineral rights to the Brunei National Petroleum Company Sendirian Berhad within the designated area referred to as Block N having the following co-ordinates - Point Latitude (N) Longitude (E) NZ-04 585500.00 513504.00 N3-13 I 581000.00 541500.00 : N3-21 579000.00 544500.00 N3-23 I 580000.00 545000.00 N3-24 I 581000.00 545000.00 N3-25 581000.00 i 545500.00 i I N3-26 i 582000.00 545500.00 N3-27 I 582000.00 547500.00 ! i i i N3-69 606000.00 535500.00 Dated this 6th. day of Zulkaedah, 1431 Hijriah corresponding to the 14th. day of October, 2010.

PEHIN ORANG KA YA PEKERMA JAY A

DATO PADUKA HAJI JUDIN BIN HAJI ASAR Secretary to the Council of Ministers.
